playground.title: Playground
playground.intro: Runnable, editable versions of the core wimui recipes. Every preview below is live — the buttons click, the table filters as you type, the stepper moves — and "Open in StackBlitz" boots a full Vite + React 19 project against the published wimui package, already wired with the required styles.css and WimProvider. Expand "View source" to see the exact code that ships to the sandbox.
playground.note: The sandboxes install wimui from npm and open in a new tab. The previews here render the same source you send to StackBlitz — they can't drift, because both come from one file.
